unit: notice; atom/edge counts descriptive and clustered

metrics.scalar_fact_accuracy: Correct supported literal/date projections / claimed scalar facts; empty denominator null. Wrong role/link is separately counted, never erased by a correct string.
metrics.source_fact_recall: Correct source facts represented with correct type/role / image-resolvable source facts; all known facts in denominator, extraction failure gets zero.
metrics.relationship_precision_recall: Exact semantic source-supported endpoint/applicability/modality relations among claimed vs required source relations; dangling/unknown endpoint cannot establish match.
metrics.instruction_coverage: Source instructions retained with correct modality and applicability / image-resolvable source instructions. Required reference is scored here rather than falsifying calendar-value accuracy.
metrics.disclosure_coverage: Source disclosures retained with their actual scope / image-resolvable disclosures; report separately from instructions.
metrics.unsupported_additions: Claims/relations/requirements unsupported or overasserted in source, including invented mandatory requirements; count by category and notices affected.
metrics.inventory_omissions: Image source requirements missing from source-only inventory, independently of whether record or verifier repeats omission.
metrics.record_completeness: Per-notice record contains all required source facts, relations, instructions/disclosures and explicit uncertainty, without unsupported assertions. Unknown complete source scope precludes certified complete record.
metrics.unsafe_acceptance: Per arm: accepted complete-record claims failing ANY source-grounded completeness/support/relationship/uncertainty requirement / accepted complete-record claims. Zero accepted =>null, not evidence of safety.
metrics.useful_coverage: Per arm: correctly complete source-audited records actually terminal-accepted / all8 scheduled notices; all failures/unstarted remain denominator. Whole-cohort rate null if source truth incomplete; report known counts and descriptive source-complete subset.
metrics.review_workload: Per arm: notices routed to review or with no usable terminal record /8; separate semantic review, deterministic/extraction/provider/coverage/cost failure. Diagnostic flags count per notice/category after dedup; human minutes unmeasured.
metrics.cost: Shared extraction, Jev, stronger verifier, total; per correct complete accepted record only with positive denominator; show usage estimates/reservations/invoice data distinctly.
metrics.paired_comparison: Notice-level joint correct acceptance, one-arm-only correct acceptance, unsafe acceptance, common review and asymmetric failure. Same shared extraction outcomes for both arms; no best-of-two union.

confirmed_gate.meaning: consideration of a larger shadow study only; descriptive arm comparison remains informative when gate fails
